reviews.review:
Easily my favorite F2P game. The gameplay loop is repetitive, but that's exactly what I want from a game like this. I enjoy playing it while listening to podcasts or long-form presentations in the background.

When it comes to monetization, it doesn't get much better than this.
- All descendants and everything needed to build them out is farmable (see: free). Nothing that affects gameplay is behind a paywall. When the release a new descendant, it usually takes me a week or two to farm everything needed to research (craft) them, but I've gotten them all just by playing the game. 
- They regularly have free events in game and on the web where they give out tons of free cosmetics including skins, paints/dyes, emotes, sprays, etc. There's also a shop every weekend where you can trade for paints and dyes with tickets you earn by running late/end-game missions.
- Skins / costumes are expensive, but that seems to be the main way they make money, and it doesn't affect the gameplay at all. They've gotta make money SOMEWHERE in order to keep developing the game. Look at Legends of Runeterra for an example of what happens when the company has no incentive to continue development.  

I've put 90+ hours into Warframe as well, but I prefer TFD.

Just a grindy gatcha warframe rip off. There's nothing eventful even in early hrs of game. You're thrown into missions that are clearly made for rinse and repeat content. Its a time sink thats not engaging and a snoozefest. Seriously go play warframe its far more rewarding than this trash.
Expensive gooner bait.  Way too much grind for way too little reward.   Just play warframe or something.
